overview_description.description:
Pietra is the operating system for commerce that gives everyone the tools they need to start and scale their own brand.

Everything a business needs to turn their passion into a creative business is in one place. Using Pietra's innovative platform to find and manage their suppliers, plug into a global fulfillment network, and use eCommerce to start selling their products online.

product.name: Sourcing & Production
product.description: A platform service providing access to over 1300 vetted factories for product manufacturing, with streamlined invoicing, tracking, and expert assistance.

product.name: Logistics & Fulfillment
product.description: A storage and order fulfillment service for small and medium businesses, offering warehousing, picking, packing, and shipping with no minimums and human account management.

product.name: Sales & Marketing Tools
product.description: Software tools to support brand growth across multiple sales channels, including email list building, retail distribution, and marketing content creation.

product.name: AI Clothing Model Generator
product.description: An AI-powered tool that generates realistic images of models wearing uploaded clothing items to aid fashion design and e-commerce presentations.

product.name: Custom Packaging Sourcing
product.description: A service to source and produce custom packaging products including mailer boxes, shipping boxes, labels, and bags from vetted factories.

product.name: Freelancers & Agencies Marketplace
product.description: A platform to hire specialized freelancers and agencies for design, marketing, manufacturing consulting, and website development services.
